title: Tanker report - Week 44
summary:
Clean
LR2
The TC1 75kt MEG/Japan index shed 99 points this week to WS1003, with the corresponding Baltic round-trip TCE falling by $33,200 to $288,700/day. For the TC20 90kt MEG/UK-Continent run, the index edged up by $43,800 to $21.86 million, corresponding to $342,700/day on Baltic round trip. The TC15 80kt Mediterranean/East index dropped by $830,000 to $11.12 million, with the Baltic round-trip TCE declining by $12,600 to $101,800/day.

children.title: VLCC
children.summary: VLCC rates on the Baltic Exchange routes appear to have found a floor at the back end of last week, with rates rebounding this week. The TD3C route (270,000mt Middle East Gulf/China) has risen 48 points since last Friday to WS1262.5, producing a daily round-trip TCE of $1,345,710 for the standard Baltic VLCC.

children.title: Suezmax
children.summary: In the Suezmax sector, the weaker trend continued across the Baltic Exchange routes. The rate for the 130,000mt Nigeria/UK Continent voyage (TD20) fell almost 14 points to WS713.89, giving a daily round-trip TCE of over $396,100.

children.title: Aframax
children.summary: In the North Sea, the rate for the 80,000mt Cross-UK Continent route (TD7) fell back about 20 points this week to around WS570, giving a daily round-trip TCE of just over $466,000 basis Hound Point/Wilhelmshaven. In the Mediterranean, the rate for the 80,000mt Cross-Mediterranean route (TD19) tumbled 137 points to around WS703.
